title: ಯುಗಳಾಂಗುರೀಯ
author: ಬಿ. ವೆಂಕಟಾಚಾರ್ಯ
description: ಬಂಕಿಮಚಂದ್ರ ಚಟರ್ಜಿಯವರ ಬಂಗಾಳಿ ಕಾದಂಬರಿಕೆ ‘ಯುಗಳಾಂಗುರೀಯ’ವನ್ನು ಬಿ. ವೆಂಕಟಾಚಾರ್ಯರು ೧೯೧೩ರಲ್ಲಿ ಕನ್ನಡಕ್ಕೆ ತಂದ ಅನುವಾದ ಇದು. ತಾಮ್ರಲಿಪ್ತದ ವರ್ತಕ ಧನದಾಸನ ಮಗಳು ಹಿರಣ್ಮಯಿ, ಬಾಲ್ಯಸ್ನೇಹಿತ ಪುರಂದರ, ಗುರು ಆನಂದಸ್ವಾಮಿ ಕಣ್ಣುಕಟ್ಟಿ ನಡೆಸಿದ ಗುಟ್ಟಿನ ಮದುವೆ, ಒಂದೇ ಬಗೆಯ ಎರಡು ಉಂಗುರಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ರಾಜ ಮದನದೇವನ ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆ — ಇವುಗಳ ಸುತ್ತ ಹೆಣೆದ ಹತ್ತು ಪರಿಚ್ಛೇದಗಳ ಪ್ರೇಮಕಥೆ.

provenance.licenseNote: Translator B. Venkatacharya (ಬಿ. ವೆಂಕಟಾಚಾರ್ಯ, 1845–1914) died on 26 June 1914 (Kannada Wikipedia ಬಿ.ವೆಂಕಟಾಚಾರ್ಯ; ಮೈಸೂರು ವಿಶ್ವವಿದ್ಯಾನಿಲಯ ವಿಶ್ವಕೋಶ, entry ವೆಂಕಟಾಚಾರ್ಯ, ಬಿ, which gives 1845–1914), and the author of the Bengali original, Bankim Chandra Chattopadhyay (1838–1894), died on 8 April 1894 (Wikidata Q377881; English Wikipedia 'Bankim Chandra Chatterjee'), so both the translation and the original are public domain in India (life + 60). Text is the Kannada Wikisource transcription of the 1913 edition (Narasimharaja Wadiyar Series; M. S. Rao & Co., Booksellers, Bangalore City; printed by P. Pallonjee at the G.T.A. Press, Mysore; the translator's own ವಿಜ್ಞಾಪನೆ is dated ಮೈಸೂರು, ಮಾರ್ಚಿ 1913), scanned as ಪರಿವಿಡಿ:ಯುಗಳಾಂಗುರೀಯ.djvu; every page used (ಪುಟ ೧೦–೩೭) is at ProofreadPage quality level 4 ('validated'). The exact ಪುಟ: pages per chapter are listed in sources.txt beside this file. Only the translator's text of the novella was taken: the title page, the translator's ವಿಜ್ಞಾಪನೆ and his dedication to his late wife, the invocation heading above the first chapter, the English printer's colophon and the blank pages were dropped, as were running headers, page numbers, signature marks and ornaments; no later editor's material is in the book. Every page was checked against the scan image 2026-11-02; paragraphs were re-joined across print-line and page breaks, and the OCR slips of the validated text and the plain misprints of the 1913 print were corrected to the printed or evident reading as listed in sources.txt.
